goal: Decide whether an observation of a CHAOSS metric enters the UOR Foundation community model.

app.name: uor-observation-admission
app.title: CHAOSS observation admission
app.purpose: Admit an observation of a CHAOSS metric into the UOR Foundation community model only when the metric is released, an oracle in standards.lock covers its data source, the data is pinned, the oracle's offline replay reproduces it, and the source's collection policy and the contribution attribution policy permit it.

fields.name: metric
fields.means: whether the metric is in chaoss/register.json, the CHAOSS knowledge base's released set

fields.name: oracle
fields.means: whether an oracle in standards.lock lists the observation's data source under covers, lists it under does_not_cover, or is not listed for it

fields.name: source
fields.means: whether the observed data is pinned to a commit or a sha256 content digest

fields.name: replay
fields.means: whether the oracle's offline replay over the pinned fixture reproduces the observation, gives another value, or has not run

fields.name: collection
fields.means: the XACML decision of the source's collection policy app, such as uor-discord-read: permit, deny, outside for NotApplicable, indeterminate; or ungoverned when no collection policy governs the source

fields.name: attribution
fields.means: the uor-contribution-attribution decision for an observation that credits contributors (organization for its NotApplicable, an organization's contribution), or aggregate when it credits no one

meanings.permit: the observation is admitted and counts toward its metric
meanings.deny: the observation is refused, and its metric stays an open claim
meanings.not-applicable: the metric is not a released CHAOSS metric, so nothing is admitted for it
meanings.indeterminate: the observation cannot be checked yet: no oracle is listed for its source, or its replay or a policy decision is pending

rules.why: chaoss/register.json (CC-01): the released CHAOSS set is the knowledge base sitemap; an unreleased metric is outside the model
XACML 3.0 7.11: the source's collection policy denied the read, so data from it is never admitted
XACML 3.0 7.11: the collection policy that governs the source did not permit the read, so nothing collected under it is admitted
W3C PROV-O: credit the delegation record does not support is not admitted (uor-contribution-attribution)
standards.lock does_not_cover: the oracle declares the source outside what it validates, so the metric stays an open claim (AGENTS.md R2)
AGENTS.md R2 and CLAUDE.md: reuse is checked on read; data not pinned to a commit or digest cannot be re-derived
GrimoireLab Perceval offline replay: a replay that gives another value refutes the observation
Alex's rule: an observation is validated by the strongest oracle; with none listed for its source it cannot be validated yet
CLAUDE.md: a failed or missing check is a miss, and a miss does the work in full before the result is trusted
XACML 3.0 7.11: the collection policy could not decide, so neither can admission
uor-contribution-attribution: the person cannot be determined until their identity is resolved

app.otherwiseWhy: a released metric, an oracle that covers the source, pinned data whose replay reproduces it, and collection and attribution both permitted, an organization's, or ungoverned

properties.why: only released CHAOSS metrics are measured
every admitted observation is validated by an oracle that covers its source
every admitted observation was reproduced by its oracle
data a collection policy denied is never admitted
data collected outside its governing policy is never admitted
credit PROV-O delegation does not support is never admitted
a released metric's observation from a denied source is refused, not left undecided

examples.request: released covers pinned reproduced ungoverned aggregate
released covers pinned reproduced permit permit
released covers pinned reproduced ungoverned organization
unreleased covers pinned reproduced permit permit
released covers pinned reproduced deny permit
released covers pinned reproduced outside aggregate
released covers pinned reproduced ungoverned deny
released excludes pinned reproduced permit aggregate
released covers unpinned reproduced ungoverned aggregate
released covers pinned differs ungoverned aggregate
released unlisted pinned reproduced permit aggregate
released covers pinned absent ungoverned aggregate
released covers pinned reproduced indeterminate aggregate
released covers pinned reproduced ungoverned indeterminate

stakeholders.name: Community and Outreach Committee
stakeholders.text: Reads the CHAOSS metrics models of the Foundation's community and needs every number behind them validated.

stakeholders.name: Contributor
stakeholders.text: Is counted by contributor metrics and needs to be credited only as PROV-O delegation records.

stakeholders.name: Verifier
stakeholders.text: Anyone who loads the holo, checks its fingerprint and replays its acceptance vectors before trusting an answer.

components.name: GrimoireLab
components.text: Perceval and SortingHat, the CHAOSS oracle in standards.lock: they collect the data, resolve identities and replay a pinned fixture offline.

components.name: Community register
components.text: chaoss/register.json and its projector, which name the released metrics and their pinned definitions.

threats.name: Unvalidated number published
threats.text: An observation no oracle reproduced is published as a CHAOSS metric of the Foundation.

control.name: Oracle replay required
control.text: Only an observation of pinned data that an oracle covering its source reproduced is admitted.

threats.name: Private data counted
threats.text: Messages a collection policy forbade reading, or credit no delegation supports, are counted.

control.name: Policies decide first
control.text: A denied or not-applicable collection decision and a denied attribution are refused before anything else is weighed.

threats.name: Request misstates the evidence
threats.text: The request claims a replay or a policy decision that did not happen.
threats.accepted: The app decides on the evidence it is given; running the oracle and the policy apps and reporting their results belongs to the collector that sends the request.

quality.text: Each of the register, oracle coverage, pinning, replay, collection and attribution checks is a rule.
